name: Moving solids over an unreliable transport: under net_fakeloss 0.3, net_fakedup 0.3, net_fakereorder 30, net_fakejitter 20 and net_fakelag 40, alice boards gs_megabyte's west up escalator, rides it, walks up it and jumps on it; every command runs exactly once and the client's prediction (replays on the same command clock, so the treads are where the server has them) agrees with the server every tick; she ends standing on the upper floor
